source.name: O Jogo: Académico de Viseu revela mais dois jogos de preparação
source.quote: uma parceria com a DAZN, marca presente que se fará notar na manga esquerda dos novos equipamentos
source.note: The club's own announcement of the same day (https://academicodeviseu.pt/noticia.php?n=1332) puts the DAZN brand on its match shirts; O Jogo names the left sleeve.

source.name: Footy Headlines: Académico de Viseu 26-27 Liga Portugal Home, Away and Third Kits Released
source.quote: This is the Académico de Viseu 26-27 home shirt, made by Joma.
source.note: Kit maker. The club renewed its Joma deal to 2028/29 (https://academicodeviseu.pt/noticia.php?n=986).

summary: Joma-made home shirt with Visabeira's logo back on the front and DAZN on the left sleeve. Not marked complete: only Wikipedia's kit table lists the other placements (Buondi on the front, Visipapel and Quinta de Lemos on the back, Águas do Caramulo and 2PLAY on the shorts), and no club announcement or news article found names them on the 2026-27 shirt.
